Working Together, Learning for Life
Pupils love their school. Happy faces fill classrooms and corridors.
Choosing the right school is a very personal choice, but we knew within just a few minutes of stepping inside this school that it was the right one for our children. Warm and welcoming, a constant and happy buzz of activity, enthusiastic children who were proud of their school, fabulous staff and just what we wanted. It felt right. No question.
My child is happy, feels safe and goes to school with a smile on her face.
As a parent, I couldn’t be happier with The Crescent Primary School. My child comes home each day with a smile, excited to share what they’ve learnt and experienced. The school offers so many wonderful opportunities and always finds fresh, creative ways to make learning fun and engaging.
As a parent, I couldn’t be happier with The Crescent Primary School. My child comes home each day with a smile, excited to share what they’ve learnt and experienced. The school offers so many wonderful opportunities and always finds fresh, creative ways to make learning fun and engaging.
Welcome to our School
Welcome to The Crescent Primary School, a happy and inclusive school at the heart of Eastleigh, Hampshire.
Our values — Love, Aspire, Curious and Belong — shape everything we do. We work in partnership with parents to ensure every child feels valued, confident, and inspired to achieve their best in a caring environment where belonging matters.

Shooting Stars Breakfast and After School Wraparound Care
Shooting Stars Breakfast and After School Wraparound Care is open to all children attending The Crescent Primary School on a first come, first served basis. This wraparound care operates during term time only and will not be open on school closure days.
The Breakfast Club offers a tasty breakfast including choices from a variety of cereals, drinks, breads, spreads, yogurts and fruits. The After School Club offers a range of snacks and drinks (Please see the images below for an example of the snacks provided).
Both clubs provide both free play and structured play with a broad range of activities and freedom for children to choose their own activities.
Drop off and collection point for the clubs is at the double doors at the back of the car park. The car park is not accessible to cars during drop off and pick up times.
Breakfast Club 7.30am - 8.45am. Children must arrive before 8.10am if they would like to have breakfast.
£6.50 per child, per morning.
After School Club 3.25pm - 6.00pm. Children must be collected by 6.00pm or late charges will apply.
3.25pm - 4.30pm - £6.50 per child, per session.
4.15pm - 6.00pm - £6.50 per child, per session. For children attending another club or tutoring directly after school.
3.25pm - 6.00pm - £10.50 per child, per session.
All sessions must be booked and paid for using Arbor.

Clubs
All Teacher-Led After School Clubs finish at 4.15pm and children should be collected promptly from the main school doors at this time. If you do not collect your child promptly at 4.15pm they may be registered with Shooting Stars and you will be charged for a short session.
All Teacher-Led Clubs are an extension of the school day and registers are taken accordingly. If your child has been enrolled in a club and does not attend, the office staff have to locate and account for that child. If your child has been in school but cannot attend their club due to an appointment - please ensure you have informed the office of their absence. If your child misses two sessions, without prior notice, their place will be given to the next child on the waiting list. Please inform the office if your child decides they no longer wish to attend their club so we can offer their place to the next child on the waiting list.
We have a number of externally run clubs that use our premises. Please be aware that these are paid clubs such as Sketch, Dodgeball, Karate, Blue Butterflies or ICON Sports and run their own timetables.
